payload.reason: The experiments focus on the specific domain of question-answering (Q&A) sites, particularly analyzing the characteristics of questions on Quora to determine their answerability.

claims.text: The study focuses on the answerability of questions on Quora, specifically examining the differences between open questions and answered ones.
The experiments are limited to a small set of questions due to the complexity of characterizing question quality and answerability.
The research quantifies linguistic activities to predict whether questions will be answered, indicating a specific focus on language use in the Q&A domain.
The analysis includes psycholinguistic aspects of question askers, further emphasizing the domain-specific focus on how language affects question answerability.
